instruction:
Background: `/tmp_workspace/contract_v1.pdf` and `/tmp_workspace/contract_v2.pdf` are two versions of the same synthetic regulation/contract corpus (30 pages, each with several numbered paragraphs). v2 has gone through a "print → scan" flow and is rasterised into an **image-only PDF with no text layer** (direct `pdftotext` extraction returns empty). Note: the literal `MODIFIED CLAUSE` marker in v2 is a synthesizer artefact and **appears on every one of the 30 pages**, but only a subset of those pages correspond to genuine substantive clause changes — the rest are clerical / non-substantive distractors. You must make a semantic judgement before tagging; mechanically annotating every page that carries the marker is not allowed.

Goal: produce a "second-pass redline" work product — annotate v2 as a PDF, export those annotations into structured data, write a redline analysis report, and capture 4 working screenshots. All final outputs **must** be placed under `/tmp_workspace/results/<filename>`; anything outside that directory does not count.

### Hard constraints on the main deliverable `contract_v2_annotated.pdf`

- Annotations must be **truly embedded in the PDF file** (visible in the page's `/Annots` dict when read with pypdf or similar)
- Total annotations ≥ 12, spread across ≥ 8 distinct pages
- Each of the three PDF annotation subtypes meets its quota:
  - `/Highlight` ≥ 6
  - `/StrikeOut` ≥ 4
  - `/Text` or `/FreeText` (pop-up note / text annotation) ≥ 8
- Each pop-up note ≤ 80 characters and must start with a risk-level prefix (`[HIGH]` / `[MED]` / `[LOW]`); all three levels must appear at least once

### Companion deliverables (all under `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

| File | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `annotations_export.md` | Markdown annotation listing with ≥ 12 `Page <N>` entries, each carrying page number + type + text |
| `annotations.json` | Valid JSON array of length ≥ 12; each entry contains at least a `subtype` (or `type`) field plus a `page` (or `page_no` / `page_index`) field |
| `changes.md` | ≥ 12 change records, each containing `Page <N>` / `Type: substantive\|clerical` / `Old:` ≤ 30 chars / `New:` ≤ 30 chars / `Risk: HIGH\|MED\|LOW`; covers at least 12 distinct `Page N` values |
| `redline_summary.md` | Must contain 3 sections: `## 高风险变更` (≥ 4 entries, each with a reject-or-revise rationale), `## 中性变更` (≥ 1 entry), `## 利好变更` (≥ 1 entry) |

### Four working screenshots (under `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

Fixed filenames:

| # | Filename | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `okular_01_two_pane.png` | Two-pane layout / thumbnail navigation + main document area |
| 2 | `okular_02_annotation_panel.png` | Annotation list panel (showing types and entries) |
| 3 | `okular_03_highlight_inline.png` | Zoomed in on a highlighted passage + readable pop-up note text |
| 4 | `okular_04_strikeout_inline.png` | Zoomed in on a struck-out passage |

Per-screenshot requirements:
- File size ≥ 50 KB, shortest side ≥ 720 px
- All 4 screenshots must have distinct md5 hashes (no reusing the same image / thumbnail snap / all-black screen)
- Each screenshot must show real, legible PDF reader panels or toolbar text (evaluation runs OCR on the screenshots)

parameters.warmup:
which okular >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq || true && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq okular okular-extra-backends || true)
which pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1 || DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils || true
which tesseract >/dev/null 2>&1 || DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr || true
pip install -q pypdf pdfplumber pdfannots 2>/dev/null || pip install -q --break-system-packages pypdf pdfplumber pdfannots 2>/dev/null || true
pip install -q pytesseract pillow numpy 2>/dev/null || pip install -q --break-system-packages pytesseract pillow numpy 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results || true

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
